restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 62 and 1024t + 64 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length. The two blocks share every word except w4 and w5 (w4' = w4 + 2, w5' = w5 - 2, Lemma L62 of proof.md Section 8); bytes 62 and 63 are zero in both (w15 < 2^16), w13 = b2077fc6 and w14 is free. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 9 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7 (Lemma L62, Fact P62 on the pin W4 = a40d3321, X3 = 435d473f, X7 = 9895859e, X11 = 9003b0e0, X15 = a7590cb9, W13 = b2077fc6, Lemma H62, Theorem C62). The first value e of E3 ranges over the class of eta = 85492711 (2^20 values), E1.c1 over the cube of beta = f5519714 (2^16 values), and t is solved per trial; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only the two outcome rows tau = aaaf751e and aaaf771e (eps = 2559f8e8) are searched; by Lemma RES (proof.md 10.2) a trial completes the collision with a row's outcome exactly when five explicit word equations hold, and the exact local counts of the rows give the model mass mu = 36583/2^121 per raw proposal (10.3). Heuristic part: B = 2^105.318 raw proposals succeed with probability at least 0.39 under H1-62 and H4-62. The 76-byte record (12.1) enters only through facts verified exactly in the proof (Lemma ADV).

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units per target compression, at most 16 live registers. Charged (proof.md Sections 11 to 13): 29,120 per batch of seven scalar raw proposals with their E lookups, 80 per E-positive proposal, 4,128 + 44,543,808 per solver entry (the solver cap at every entry), tables 2^29, 16 boundary units, the selection procedure SEL at its cap S_SEL = 6 * 2^58 + 2^50 word operations (12.2) and 2^38 compressions to write and verify the messages. The filters and the solver are specified and proved in Section 11 (Lemmas NEC, AUT, CR, FM, LS). The budgets (J batches, LE E-positive proposals, L2 solver entries) are halts charged at bound plus one; no mean of a work count is used. These are proved upper allowances of a specified layout; nothing is implemented or measured.

A distinct path filed at its own price. time_log2 109.2779 is the bound (O_run + S_SEL)/430 + 2^38 rounded up at the fourth decimal and checked by integer 10,000th powers on both sides (proof.md 13.3). Success 0.39 holds only under H1-62 (rate factor 51 per 2^128 and weak dependence) and H4-62 (budgets); no premise about a selection procedure is used (proof.md Lemma ADV). No full 2-round collision is exhibited.

The submitted program and the two experiments are those of entry 26ebba63, unchanged: they run the 55/63 root instance (single chunks of 55 and 63 bytes, counter 0, flags 11; proof.md Sections 3 to 6). The program does not run this path: nothing of the 62/64 construction, the pin, the class, the cube, the filters or the solver is in it, and no implementation of any part of this path has been run. The local exact counts of proof.md Section 10 and the runs of SEL (12.2) were made by participant programs outside the package.

memory_log2_bytes 44 bounds everything held at once: the two messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the lookup tables (311,296 bytes), the solver, the 76-byte advice record and the selection procedure SEL, whose every program run halts when it holds 2^36 bytes (proof.md 12.2, 14). preprocessing_log2 52 bounds the tables and SEL, (S_SEL + 2^29)/430 < 2^51.8378 target compressions, and is included in time_log2. The search reads 76 bytes of fixed nonuniform advice (the 24-byte pin, eta, beta, eps and the two rows with their class, cube and solver words; proof.md 12.1), declared as nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 6.248 (76 < 2^6.248); the computation that found them is SEL, charged at its cap. No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. For the actual sampler of proof.md 11.1 (the pin of 8.2; the seven outer words, r = w14 uniform on all words, z = w15 uniform on 0..65535 and a member e of the class of eta = 85492711 drawn with fresh coins per raw proposal; E1.c1 over the cube of beta = f5519714; the two outcome rows aaaf751e and aaaf771e), (i) the expected number of valid listed roots of one raw proposal is at least (N_c - 1) * f / 2^128 with N_c = 2^16 and f = floor(5 * 36583 / 3584) = 51, five sevenths of the model rate per trial (36583 / 2^137 = 71.45 * 2^-128) rounded down; and (ii) the probability that the unhalted run of B = 50,575,779,322,124,053,188,182,925,749,242 raw proposals has no listed root is at most exp(-0.49676) + 0.001. The 55/63 premise of the participant's earlier entries is not transferred.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 9 to 11: lengths 1024t + 62 and 1024t + 64 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the pin of Section 8, e in the class of eta (2^20 values), c1 in the cube of beta (2^16 values), t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped, and only the two rows of Section 10.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the exact local counts of proof.md 10.3, defined there from the row equations of Lemma RES (10.2): L = 2^27 and N3Sigma = 47 * 2^57 for tau = aaaf771e, L = 2^28 and N3Sigma = 12519 * 2^47 for tau = aaaf751e, pair mass mu = 36583 / 2^121 = 2^-105.8411 per raw proposal under the counting model of 10.3 (independent uniform words), taken at five sevenths and rounded down. Participant evidence (10.4, untrusted by the harness): an exhaustive local screen of the 15,180-pair grid found exactly these two positive rows, and an independent recount, brute-force-checked at widths 6 to 8, agrees exactly on L and N3Sigma of both rows and fixed the normalization of mu at 2^196. The local mass of E1 and E3 does not prove the physical first moment or the dependence clause.
heuristics.limitations: Declared, not proved and not measured. No rate of this path has been measured at any width: no implementation of the path exists, and the organizer-run experiments run the 55/63 root instance of entry 26ebba63's program, which contains nothing of this path. The factor 51 and the dependence clause are assumed. The definitions of L and N3Sigma, the filters' necessity and the solver's listing of every root are stated and proved in proof.md 10.2 to 11.4.

heuristics.statement: Supporting, filtered path only. The probability that the count of E-positive raw proposals exceeds LE = 219,723,112,305,481,250,688,653,171,096 or the count of solver entries exceeds L2 = 2,871,968,522,982,158,364,169,218,308 is at most 0.0005. A sufficient form: the raw proposals are independent and P(E-positive) <= 1.06 pE, P(both masks meet) <= 1.06 p2, with pE = 8575 / 2^21 and p2 = 7345443 / 2^37; Chernoff then gives the budgets, each ceil(17/16 * B * share).
heuristics.scope: The two counts of proof.md 11.1 over the B raw proposals of the run; the indicators of one proposal may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The shares are exact for uniform independent input words: the exact input-word histograms of the two existence automata of proof.md 11.2 (Lemma AUT), computed by the participant's arithmetic script over all 2^32 words, give pE and p2 in exact arithmetic. The budgets LE and L2 are computed exactly from B and the shares.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved and not measured: the sampler's words Q = Y9 and E = e + w8 are not proved uniform, and nothing of this path has been run. The time bound does not depend on this premise, since every count halts at its budget.
